notes.title: Update 1 - Basic controller support
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm happy to share the first small update to Fork-U that adds basic support for controllers. This means you should now be able to use your controller to navigate the forklift completely. Some UI navigation still requires a mouse and keyboard but it should mostly work. Once you tap a button on the controller it should recognize and switch over the control scheme.

Important Note:

I have only tested with an Xbox controller so your milage may vary. If you have a different controller, please let me know if it works or if you encounter any issues.

As always, your feedback helps improve the game, so please share your experiences and suggestions.

Happy Forklifting!

notes.title: Fork-U Now Available in Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey fellow forklift operators!

I’m really excited (and a bit nervous!) to announce that my game, Fork-U, is officially available on Steam Early Access. As a solo developer, this project has been a labor of love, and I can’t wait for you to finally experience it.

In Fork-U, you’ll step into the role of a forklift operator in a world built around realistic physics and relaxing gameplay. Whether you're in a busy warehouse or navigating a construction site, you’ll feel the weight of every pallet and the challenge of different terrains, making each task a fun little puzzle to solve.

I wanted to create something that feels both engaging and calming. There’s no time pressure, no external stress—just you, your forklift, and the satisfying task of getting things done right. From loading pallets to carefully stacking shelves, it’s all about precision and skill at your own pace. Plus, the ambient sounds in the background add to that peaceful vibe.

This game is for anyone who finds joy in the little details or just wants a chill, meditative experience. Whether you're into forklifts or just looking for a relaxing escape, Fork-U offers a unique way to unwind.

I’d love for you to check it out and share your thoughts! Your feedback means the world to me as I keep refining the game during Early Access.

Get Fork-U on Steam now and start your forklift adventure! Thanks so much for your support—this journey wouldn’t be possible without the support from you early adopters. ❤️


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3220300/ForkU/
